# PiBot Repository Context

For questions about project status, current work, open issues, priorities, next steps, task planning, checkpoints, or engineering history, read `"docs/AI Engineering Framework/project_state.json"` before answering.

For tasks that modify implementation, architecture, validation, documentation, or engineering workflow, read `"docs/AI Engineering Framework/project_state.json"` first and follow the applicable standards in `"docs/AI Engineering Framework/"`.

Treat current implementation and direct runtime evidence as authoritative when they conflict with documentation.

Modify only files materially affected by the assigned task. Preserve known-good behavior and avoid unrelated changes.

Do not update `"docs/AI Engineering Framework/project_state.json"` unless the task explicitly authorizes it or the documented lifecycle assigns that responsibility.
